episode_event_salon_pasiosalon_date_ch00:
[Name:PlayerNickname ] and Whitney
were having a Pokémon battle.
And the result was...
Ugh... I lost!
*sniffle*
(Tell her she was strong.)

I...I don’t need your comfort! Don’t worry!
I’m just fine!
(Ask if she’s OK.)
Of course I am! Don’t worry about me!

I can’t help but cry when I’m disappointed.
But I can’t wallow forever!
Well, I accept it—I totally lost!

You truly are a strong Trainer,
[Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Pasio has so many strong people like you...

So for me, Pokémon battling has just been a
cycle of winning and losing!
It’s frustrating to lose...

But thanks to you, I’m slowly getting better
at holding back my tears!
I’ve battled you countless times.

And those experiences sharpened my skills
and mindset as a Trainer! So...thanks!
(Say you’re happy to help.)
I knew you’d accept my thanks with grace!

(Chuckle and say you’ll train her even
more, then.)
Ha! Someone’s feeling bold today!

You got me this time, but I can’t stay beaten
forever!

I’ll repay you for my loss—and as thanks
for battling with me! Just you wait!
A few days later...

Whitney asked [Name:PlayerNickname ]
to meet at a certain place...

As thanks for all you’ve done, I wanted to
treat you to coffee!

This place is famous for their coffee. It tastes
super bitter and sophisticated!

Looks like they also serve coffee with plenty
of milk.

(Say you want the same thing
as her.)
Oh? Trying to compete with me?
(Ask if she thinks she can handle it.)
How rude!
Don’t underestimate the great Whitney!

OK! You’re on! Let’s see which of us has
more sophisticated taste!
Oof... It’s...it’s more bitter than I expected...

Maybe our taste buds aren’t sophisticated
enough yet. But I don’t want it to go to
waste.
(Suggest adding sugar.)
Yeah! That could work!
(Suggest adding milk.)
Yeah! No need to drink it as is!
You know, might as well add BOTH!

The two of them added milk and sugar and
drank their coffee...
Whew...

Now it’s sweet and mild—and goes
down easy!
This battle was a draw, but I still had fun!

Oh yeah! Now that we’re done battling,
want to have some of this?
Ta-da! It’s Moomoo Milk!

I brought it to drink with you,
[Name:PlayerNickname ].

Coffee’s good and all, but at the end of the
day, I can’t go without my Moomoo Milk!

Anyway, it’s been so much fun trying new
things with you outside of Pokémon battling!

Come on, [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
Let’s keep having fun together!
